column2: Payments to XXXX XXXX XXXX/Transworld : XX/XX/XXXX {$150.00} XX/XX/XXXX {$130.00} XX/XX/XXXX {$710.00} Total : {$990.00} This company had garnished my taxes last year on XX/XX/XXXX and I had made payments towards the balance due the previous dates listed above as well, but because of them charging me interest ( about XXXX $ ) every month, It had built up to the same amount balance I owed last year. Therefore I am just repaying the same amount I paid last year and the remaining balance due. Which is basically paying the total debt amount due twice instead of one time. Ive called the supervisor twice to resolve this issue and the company itself several times to resolve this issue but theyre saying even with me setting up a payment plan theyre going to charge me about XXXX $ a month anyway.

I switched mortgage companies and thought I canceled the ach for XXXX so that I could use the payment for my old mortgage company for my new mortgage. Long story short the funds for my last mortgage with Mr cooper did not reach them Or so that is what I was told on the phone. I call the bank ( XXXX ) and they say that there is nothing they can do to receive the funds because I authorized it. So now Mr.cooper scam mortgage company has my money in limbo. All I want is the money to go back into my account so I can pay my mortgage. But no one is helping me and I am extremely frustrated with the whole process altogether. The first time I called they said that they never received my final payment. So $ XXXX is just no where to be found apparently even though it came out of my account.

On XX/XX/2019, I wrote to Capital One, requesting closure of my 360 account, which I no longer use. I received no response, and my account remained open. So I sent Capital One an electronic message through its online messaging function. Still no reply, and my account remained open. So I faxed Capital One at the customer service fax number displayed on its website : XXXX. My account remains open against my wishes and specific instructions. This appears an attempt to continue counting me as a banking customer and extracting fees against my wishes. I anticipate getting hit with account maintenance fees for lack of maintaining a minimum balance or direct deposit. Contacting the CFPB and law enforcement is my last resort to get Capital One 's attention on my requested account closure.
